sections.content: You know passive *se* (*se busca*, *se buscan*) from B1 Unit 6. Environmental regulations use passive *se* constantly in compound tenses and modal periphrases, where agreement mistakes are common. When a modal verb (*deber, poder, tener que*) combines with passive *se* before a plural noun, the conjugated modal agrees in the plural (*Se deben prohibir los vertidos industriales*, *Se pueden recuperar los humedales*). In compound tenses, *haber* agrees in the plural while the participle stays invariant (*Se han aprobado planes de restauración ecológica*). By contrast, when the subject is an infinitive clause rather than a noun, the verb stays singular (*Se prohíbe talar sin permiso*).

sections.title: Passive *se* agreement in regulations
rows: Plural modal (*Se deben controlar los vertidos en cada humedal.*)
*haber* agrees, participle stays *-o* (*Se han frenado las talas ilegales.*)
Always singular (*Se prohíbe arrojar desechos cerca del humedal.*)

items.spanish: Se deben controlar los vertidos químicos para garantizar la conservación del humedal.
items.english: Chemical discharges must be controlled to guarantee the conservation of the wetland.

items.spanish: En los últimos años se han impulsado programas de restauración ecológica y reciclaje urbano.
items.english: In recent years, ecological-restoration and urban-recycling programmes have been promoted.

items.spanish: Se prohíbe la tala comercial en zonas protegidas y se prohíben también los vertidos sin tratamiento.
items.english: Commercial logging is prohibited in protected areas, and untreated discharges are also prohibited.

items.spanish: Se recomienda separar los materiales para facilitar el reciclaje municipal.
items.english: Separating materials is recommended to facilitate municipal recycling.

sections.content: Check what the real grammatical subject is. In *Se prohíbe fumar en el parque*, the subject is the infinitive action (singular). In *Se prohíben las talas en el parque*, the subject is the plural noun *las talas*, so the verb must be plural.
